listed_sector_signals.signal: Cited reference to an energy audit of a steel mill (continuous primary-metals production) — appears only in the bibliography, not as the paper's own application
listed_sector_signals.quote:
Ho, J.C., Chou, S.K., Chandratilleke, T.T., 1991. Energy audit of a steel mill, Energy, 16
(7), 1021e1029. July 1991.
listed_sector_signals.sector: steel and other primary-metals continuous production

one_line: The paper proposes an Energy Management Maturity Model (a self-assessment organizational tool consistent with ISO 50001) applicable to any industry or service company, and demonstrates it on a pharmaceutical manufacturing facility; the only continuous-flow sector mention (a steel mill) is a bibliographic citation, not an application.
